Module io.github.teceli.resiliencia.patterns
Package io.github.teceli.resiliencia.patterns.circuitbreaker

Interface CircuitState

All Known Implementing Classes:
CircuitState.Closed, CircuitState.HalfOpen, CircuitState.Open
public sealed interface CircuitState permits CircuitState.Closed, CircuitState.Open, CircuitState.HalfOpen
The state of a CircuitBreaker at a point in time. Closed, Open, and HalfOpen are the only possible states, modeled as a closed hierarchy so callers can pattern-match exhaustively.
